question: Which historical C caller-body reviews can be reused without repeating the full file audit, and which changed call boundaries need current reconciliation?
procedure: Compare all C paths since S12 closure with git diff; read entire cumulative diff for eleven changed files; read current COMMAND/directory/DPMI/VM macro contracts and guest-memory implementation; join stable IDs without altering status.
limits: 179 unchanged caller bodies are not 179 clean dependencies. Included headers and providers can change independently.
The 190 historical direct compile/link callers are not the entire 1494-file inventory. Transitive-only and previously unobserved files still require explicit disposition.
Evidence navigation entries do not automatically endorse older conclusions; P19/P24/P25 and P51 supersede the identified old mechanism descriptions.
No new build, runtime test or production modification.

Source-path references are exact JSON string/key matches in earlier S12 records, excluding the aggregate file/index/handoff inventories. They are navigation, not a fresh approval or body-review certificate.
